title: Acceptance probability of the combined verifier
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, with $n>0$. For every Boolean input $w$ and every Boolean proof of the circuit’s quadratic PCPP proof length, the combined verifier’s acceptance probability equals the average of the acceptance probabilities of its inner-function tester and input-consistency tester, each applied to the word formed from $w$ and the proof.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
A Boolean proof of the circuit’s quadratic PCPP proof length
